A little about us

Not a
club.
A crew.

YOUR PACE IS THE PACE.

There’s no right way to be a skater. There’s just showing up, trying things, and cheering each other on.

The Other Side is an imagined community built around shared space and a love of rolling. First push or hundredth trick, board or blades: you belong here. We believe the best sessions leave room for everyone.
